confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of George Town pricing for July 2026. No live menus, listings or booking pages were checked, and no web search informed the city prices. Restaurant and hostel anchors are the more reliable; hotel tiers and seasonal rate swings are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were set relative to the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weaker. The only web lookup was the RBA USD/AUD observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates reflect general knowledge of George Town and similar Malaysian heritage tourist cities, with hawker-led dining pulling restaurant anchors below Western-style pricing.
